name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre Dubois, a native of Geneva, has been immersed in the world of motorsport since his teenage years, initially as a passionate spectator at local rallies. His career began in sports journalism, covering various racing series for a Swiss publication. This experience provided him with a deep understanding of the media landscape and the importance of effective communication in motorsport.

He transitioned to public relations over a decade ago, honing his skills at smaller racing teams before joining Meyer Shank Racing. Jean-Pierre believes in building strong relationships with the media, drivers, and team personnel. He's known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to craft compelling narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike. He is dedicated to ensuring that every message reflects the team's values and goals, and is a firm believer in transparency and authenticity in communications.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a slightly serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses even when they are perfectly in place.
Insists on using a specific brand of Swiss chocolate to reward successful media interactions.
